verdict.rationale: Vendor docs claim runtime sandbox testing (TREX) that finds bugs 'only show up at runtime', a dedicated security-vulnerability agent, and v5 improvements that 'catch more bugs' with fewer false positives — all pointing at substantive, not just style, review. One independent user corroborates this ('more often than not it catches real issues'), and another found an accurate deep-codebase answer. However, other community feedback describes overzealous/nitpick behavior and unreliable indexing in some cases, so real-bug-catching is credible but not conclusively proven at scale. Missing for 10: independent benchmark or multiple hands-on reports specifically confirming logic/race-condition/edge-case bugs caught (not just security or style), and resolution of mixed community signal on reliability.
